newsitem.title: CANADA: Suncor jumps after oil sands news.
newsitem.headline: Suncor jumps after oil sands news.

text.p: Shares of Suncor Energy Inc jumped on Thursday after the company said it planned a major expansion of its northern Alberta oil sands operation.
Suncor said it planned to spend C$2.2 billion to expand its oil sands extraction and upgrading facilities, a phased project that would boost output to 210,000 barrels a day by 2002.
Suncor climbed 1.80 to 40.25 on 150,645 shares in early Thursday trade in Toronto.
The oil sands operation, located north of Fort McMurray, Alberta, currently pumps out 85,000 barrels a day of synthetic crude oil.
Suncor said the investment in its Project Millennium was expected to generate a return on capital of more than 15 percent.
